The orb of the page (static/index.html) is LiveKit's Aura audio visualizer, ported to plain JavaScript.

Source: https://github.com/livekit/components-js (Apache License 2.0, text in LICENSE-livekit-components-js.txt)
  packages/shadcn/components/agents-ui/agent-audio-visualizer-aura.tsx   (the GLSL fragment shader, the shader settings)
  packages/shadcn/hooks/agents-ui/use-agent-audio-visualizer-aura.ts     (the motion of each agent state)
  Version read: commit 1ce6ca0025 of 2026-10-07. LiveKit designed the visual in partnership with Unicorn Studio.
